takes.label: 11A
takes.notes: I think the doot-doot-doot-doot- 16th notes that come in after 20-25s take away from the coolness

takes.label: 11B
takes.notes: Not quite coherent enough, then the metronome comes in at 20 and makes it feel annoying

takes.label: 11C

redirect.metal: Accepted 10A; do not spend this round regenerating Metal.
redirect.lightning: Keep major-key plucks but add unmistakably electric timbre and purposeful rhythmic variation.
redirect.water: Keep dark coolness; add a coherent memorable sostenuto cello or bowed double-bass melody, with continuous phrasing instead of fast patterns or a newly entering metronomic beat.
